statement: Fitzner--van der Hofstad Theorem 1.1 proves, for Bernoulli nearest-neighbour bond percolation on Z^d with d>=11, a finite constant A2(d) such that tauhat_p(k)<=A2(d)/(1-Dhat(k)) uniformly for p<=pc(d), with Dhat(k)=d^{-1}sum_j cos(k_j). The requested extension is d=7,8,9,10.
assumptions: Independent undirected nearest-neighbour bond occupation with physical probability p
Dimension d>=11 for the cited theorem
